items.title: Microsoft's Gates Says AI Needs Regulation
items.summary: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates says lawmakers need to take the reins and regulate the development of artificial intelligence, days after CEOs of some of the most prominent AI labs called for a slowdown in the pace of development. "No one thinks self-regulation is enough," Gates told NBC's Meet the Press in an interview that aired on Sunday. "You need law enforcement and the politicians to get into the discussion about what safeguards and monitoring look like," Gates told the show.
